using LinearAlgebra
using Statistics

using CUDA

function aggregate_fn(original_seqs, attention_mask)
    batch_size, num_tokens, max_num_atoms_per_token = size(attention_mask)[1:3]
    if max_num_atoms_per_token != 24
        error("Only 24 atoms per token is supported")
    end
    
    aggregated_seqs = []
    for t in original_seqs
        dims = ndims(t)
        if dims == 3
            push!(aggregated_seqs, reshape(t, batch_size, num_tokens * 24, :))
        elseif dims == 4
            push!(aggregated_seqs, reshape(t, batch_size, num_tokens * 24, size(t, 4)))
        else
            new_shape = (batch_size, num_tokens * 24, size(t)[4:end]...)
            push!(aggregated_seqs, reshape(t, new_shape))
        end
    end
    
    function reverse_fn(aggregated_seqs)
        original_seqs = []
        for t in aggregated_seqs
            dims = ndims(t)
            if dims == 2
                push!(original_seqs, reshape(t, batch_size, num_tokens, 24))
            elseif dims == 3
                push!(original_seqs, reshape(t, batch_size, num_tokens, 24, size(t, 3)))
            else
                new_shape = (batch_size, num_tokens, 24, size(t)[3:end]...)
                push!(original_seqs, reshape(t, new_shape))
            end
        end
        return original_seqs
    end
    
    return aggregated_seqs, reverse_fn
end

function aggregate_fn_advanced(original_seqs, attention_mask)
    batch_size, num_tokens, max_num_atoms_per_token = size(attention_mask)[1:3]
    
    if max_num_atoms_per_token != 24
        error("Only 24 atoms per token is supported")
    end
    
    attention_mask = Bool.(attention_mask)
    
    num_atoms = sum(attention_mask, dims=(2, 3))
    
    if any(num_atoms .== 0)
        error("Some sequences have zero atoms. Please remove them before aggregation.")
    end
    
    max_atoms = maximum(num_atoms)
    
    range_tensor = 0:(max_atoms-1)
    range_tensor = repeat(reshape(range_tensor, 1, :), batch_size, 1)
    output_attention_mask = range_tensor .< reshape(num_atoms, :, 1)
    
    aggregated_seqs = []
    for t in original_seqs
        new_tensor = zeros(eltype(t), batch_size, max_atoms, size(t)[4:end]...)
        if CUDA.functional() && isa(t, CuArray)
            new_tensor = CuArray(new_tensor)
        end
        push!(aggregated_seqs, new_tensor)
    end
    
    for i in 1:length(original_seqs)
        aggregated_seqs[i][output_attention_mask] .= original_seqs[i][attention_mask]
    end
    
    function reverse_fn(aggregated_seqs)
        original_seqs = []
        
        for aggregated_seq in aggregated_seqs
            new_batch_size = size(aggregated_seq, 1)
            
            if new_batch_size != batch_size
                original_seq = zeros(eltype(aggregated_seq), new_batch_size, num_tokens, max_num_atoms_per_token, size(aggregated_seq)[3:end]...)
                if CUDA.functional() && isa(aggregated_seq, CuArray)
                    original_seq = CuArray(original_seq)
                end
                
                repeat_factor = div(new_batch_size, batch_size)
                new_attention_mask = repeat(attention_mask, repeat_factor, 1, 1)
                new_output_attention_mask = repeat(output_attention_mask, repeat_factor, 1)
                original_seq[new_attention_mask] .= aggregated_seq[new_output_attention_mask]
            else
                original_seq = zeros(eltype(aggregated_seq), batch_size, num_tokens, max_num_atoms_per_token, size(aggregated_seq)[3:end]...)
                if CUDA.functional() && isa(aggregated_seq, CuArray)
                    original_seq = CuArray(original_seq)
                end
                original_seq[attention_mask] .= aggregated_seq[output_attention_mask]
            end
            
            push!(original_seqs, original_seq)
        end
        return original_seqs
    end
    
    return aggregated_seqs, reverse_fn
end

function slice_at_dim(t, dim_slice, dim)
    dim = dim < 0 ? dim + ndims(t) : dim
    indices = [Colon() for _ in 1:ndims(t)]
    indices[dim] = dim_slice
    return t[indices...]
end

function concat_previous_and_later_windows(t, dim_seq, dim_window)
    @assert dim_seq == dim_window - 1
    
    first = slice_at_dim(t, 1:8, dim=dim_seq)
    first_shape = collect(size(first))
    first = reshape(first, first_shape[1:dim_seq-1]..., :, first_shape[dim_window+1:end]...)
    first_shape2 = collect(size(first))
    first_shape2 = [first_shape2[1:dim_seq-1]..., 1, first_shape2[dim_seq:end]...]
    first = reshape(first, first_shape2...)
    
    last = slice_at_dim(t, size(t, dim_seq)-7:size(t, dim_seq), dim=dim_seq)
    last_shape = collect(size(last))
    last = reshape(last, last_shape[1:dim_seq-1]..., :, last_shape[dim_window+1:end]...)
    last_shape2 = collect(size(last))
    last_shape2 = [last_shape2[1:dim_seq-1]..., 1, last_shape2[dim_seq:end]...]
    last = reshape(last, last_shape2...)
    
    t = pad_at_dim(t, (3, 4), dim=dim_seq, value=0.0)
    
    left = cat(
        slice_at_dim(t, 1:2:size(t,dim_seq)-7, dim=dim_seq),
        slice_at_dim(t, 2:2:size(t,dim_seq)-6, dim=dim_seq),
        slice_at_dim(t, 3:2:size(t,dim_seq)-5, dim=dim_seq),
        dims=dim_window
    )
    
    middle = cat(
        slice_at_dim(t, 4:2:size(t,dim_seq)-4, dim=dim_seq),
        slice_at_dim(t, 5:2:size(t,dim_seq)-3, dim=dim_seq),
        dims=dim_window
    )
    
    right = cat(
        slice_at_dim(t, 6:2:size(t,dim_seq)-2, dim=dim_seq),
        slice_at_dim(t, 7:2:size(t,dim_seq)-1, dim=dim_seq),
        slice_at_dim(t, 8:2:size(t,dim_seq), dim=dim_seq),
        dims=dim_window
    )
    
    t = cat(left, middle, right, dims=dim_window)
    
    t = cat(
        first, first,
        slice_at_dim(t, 3:size(t,dim_seq)-2, dim=dim_seq),
        last, last,
        dims=dim_seq
    )
    
    return t
end

function lens_to_mask(lens, max_len)
    device = lens.device
    
    if isnothing(max_len)
        max_len = maximum(lens)
    end
    
    arange = collect(0:max_len-1)
    if CUDA.functional() && isa(lens, CuArray)
        arange = CuArray(arange)
    end
    
    return reshape(arange, 1, :) .< reshape(lens, :, 1)
end

function pad_to_multiple(t, multiple; dim=-1, value=0.0)
    seq_len = size(t, dim < 0 ? ndims(t) + dim + 1 : dim)
    padding_needed = mod(multiple - mod(seq_len, multiple), multiple)
    
    if padding_needed == 0
        return t
    end
    
    return pad_at_dim(t, (0, padding_needed), dim=dim, value=value)
end

function repeat_consecutive_with_lens(feats, lens)
    b, n, rest = size(feats, 1), size(feats, 2), size(feats)[3:end]
    expanded = repeat(feats, 1, 24, 1)
    new_shape = (b, n * 24, rest...)
    return reshape(expanded, new_shape)
end

function repeat_consecutive_with_lens_advanced(feats, lens)
    device = feats.device
    dtype = eltype(feats)
    
    batch, seq = size(feats, 1), size(feats, 2)
    dims = size(feats)[3:end]
    
    mask = lens_to_mask(lens, nothing)
    
    window_size = size(mask, 2)
    arange = collect(0:window_size-1)
    if CUDA.functional() && isa(feats, CuArray)
        arange = CuArray(arange)
    end
    
    cumsum_len = cumsum(lens, dims=1)
    offsets = vcat(zeros(eltype(lens), 1), cumsum_len[1:end-1])
    indices = reshape(arange, 1, 1, :) .+ reshape(offsets, :, 1, 1)
    
    total_lens = sum(lens, dims=1)
    output_mask = lens_to_mask(total_lens, nothing)
    
    max_len = maximum(total_lens)
    
    output_indices = zeros(Int, batch, Int(max_len) + 1)
    if CUDA.functional() && isa(feats, CuArray)
        output_indices = CuArray(output_indices)
    end
    
    indices[.!mask] .= max_len
    indices = reshape(indices, batch, :)
    
    seq_arange = collect(0:seq-1)
    if CUDA.functional() && isa(feats, CuArray)
        seq_arange = CuArray(seq_arange)
    end
    seq_arange = repeat(seq_arange, window_size)
    
    for i in 1:batch
        for j in 1:size(indices, 2)
            idx = Int(indices[i, j]) + 1
            if idx <= size(output_indices, 2)
                output_indices[i, idx] = seq_arange[j] + 1
            end
        end
    end
    
    output_indices = output_indices[:, 1:end-1]
    
    output = zeros(eltype(feats), batch, size(output_indices, 2), dims...)
    if CUDA.functional() && isa(feats, CuArray)
        output = CuArray(output)
    end
    
    for i in 1:batch
        for j in 1:size(output_indices, 2)
            idx = output_indices[i, j]
            if idx > 0
                output[i, j, :] .= feats[i, idx, :]
            end
        end
    end
    
    mask_value = dtype == Bool ? false : zero(dtype)
    output = ifelse.(output_mask, output, mask_value)
    
    return output
end

function pad_and_window(t, window_size)
    t = pad_to_multiple(t, window_size, dim=2)
    b, n = size(t, 1), size(t, 2)
    rest = size(t)[3:end]
    new_shape = (b, div(n, window_size), window_size, rest...)
    return reshape(t, new_shape)
end

function mean_pool_with_lens(feats, feats_mask, lens; eps=1e-6)
    seq_len = size(feats, 2)
    
    if mod(seq_len, 24) != 0
        error("Sequence length must be divisible by 24")
    end
    
    feats = reshape(feats, size(feats, 1), div(seq_len, 24), 24, size(feats)[3:end]...)
    feats_mask = reshape(feats_mask, size(feats_mask, 1), div(seq_len, 24), 24, size(feats_mask)[3:end]...)
    
    feats = sum(feats .* reshape(feats_mask, size(feats_mask)..., 1), dims=3) ./ (sum(feats_mask, dims=3, keepdims=true) .+ eps)
    
    return feats
end

function pad_at_dim(t, pad, dim=-1, value=0.0)
    dim = dim < 0 ? ndims(t) + dim + 1 : dim
    dims_from_right = ndims(t) - dim
    
    pad_spec = []
    for i in 1:dims_from_right
        push!(pad_spec, 0, 0)
    end
    append!(pad_spec, collect(pad))
    
    return NNlib.pad_constant(t, tuple(pad_spec...), value)
end

function add(x, y; inplace=false)
    if inplace
        x .+= y
        return x
    else
        return x .+ y

function iteration(model::BackboneTrunk, feats, inits, prevs)
    outputs = Dict()
    
    dtype = Float32
    for k in keys(feats)
        if eltype(feats[k]) == Float32
            feats[k] = feats[k]
        end
    end
    
    batch_dims = size(feats["aatype"])[1:end-2]
    no_token = size(feats["aatype"])[end-1]
    
    inplace_safe = false
    
    single_mask = feats["seq_mask"]
    pair_mask = reshape(single_mask, size(single_mask)..., 1) .* reshape(single_mask, size(single_mask)[1:end-1]..., 1, size(single_mask)[end])
    msa_mask = feats["msa_mask"]
    
    s_init, z_init, s_inputs = inits
    
    s_prev = pop!(prevs)
    z_prev = pop!(prevs)
    
    if isnothing(s_prev) || isnothing(z_prev)
        s_prev = zeros(eltype(s_init), batch_dims..., no_token, model.config.input_embedder.c_s)
        z_prev = zeros(eltype(z_init), batch_dims..., no_token, no_token, model.config.input_embedder.c_z)
    end
    
    s_prev_emb, z_prev_emb = recycling_embedder_forward(model.recycling_embedder, s_prev, z_prev, inplace_safe=inplace_safe)
    
    s = add(s_init, s_prev_emb, inplace=false)
    z = add(z_init, z_prev_emb, inplace=false)
    
    s_prev = nothing
    z_prev = nothing
    s_prev_emb = nothing
    z_prev_emb = nothing
    
    if model.config.template_embedder.enabled
        template_embeds = template_embedder_forward(
            model.template_embedder,
            feats,
            z,
            pair_mask,
            chunk_size=model.globals.chunk_size,
            use_deepspeed_evo_attention=model.globals.use_deepspeed_evo_attention,
            inplace_safe=inplace_safe,
            _mask_trans=model.config._mask_trans
        )
        
        z = add(z, template_embeds, inplace_safe)
    end
    
    m, msa_mask = msa_embedder_forward(model.msa_embedder, feats, s_inputs, msa_mask, inplace_safe=inplace_safe)
    
    m, z = msa_stack_forward(
        model.msa_stack,
        m, z,
        msa_mask=msa_mask,
        pair_mask=pair_mask,
        chunk_size=model.globals.chunk_size,
        use_deepspeed_evo_attention=model.globals.use_deepspeed_evo_attention,
        inplace_safe=inplace_safe,
        _mask_trans=model.config._mask_trans
    )
    
    s, z = pairformer_forward(
        model.pairformer,
        s, z,
        single_mask=single_mask,
        pair_mask=pair_mask,
        chunk_size=model.globals.chunk_size,
        use_deepspeed_evo_attention=model.globals.use_deepspeed_evo_attention,
        inplace_safe=inplace_safe,
        _mask_trans=model.config._mask_trans
    )
    
    outputs["z"] = z
    outputs["s"] = s
    outputs["s_inputs"] = s_inputs
    
    s_prev = outputs["s"]
    z_prev = outputs["z"]
    
    return outputs, s_prev, z_prev
end

function forward(model::BackboneTrunk, feats)
    inplace_safe = false
    s_prev = nothing
    z_prev = nothing
    prevs = [s_prev, z_prev]
    
    is_grad_enabled = true
    
    num_iters = model.recycling_iters + 1
    
    s_init, z_init, s_inputs = input_embedder_forward(
        model.input_embedder,
        feats,
        chunk_size=model.globals.chunk_size,
        use_deepspeed_evo_attention=model.globals.use_deepspeed_evo_attention,
        inplace_safe=inplace_safe
    )
    inits = [s_init, z_init, s_inputs]
    
    for cycle_no in 1:num_iters
        is_final_iter = cycle_no == num_iters
        
        outputs, s_prev, z_prev = iteration(model, feats, inits, prevs)
        
        if !is_final_iter
            outputs = nothing
            prevs = [s_prev, z_prev]
            s_prev = nothing
            z_prev = nothing
        else
            break
        end
    end
    
    merge!(outputs, aux_heads_forward(model.aux_heads, outputs))
    
    return outputs
end

function flat_idx_to_idx(flat_idx, dims)
    idx = []
    for d in reverse(dims)
        pushfirst!(idx, mod(flat_idx, d))
        flat_idx = div(flat_idx, d)
    end
    return tuple(idx...)
end

function get_minimal_slice_set(start_seq, end_seq, dims; start_edges=nothing, end_edges=nothing)
    function reduce_edge_list(l)
        tally = 1
        for i in 1:length(l)
            reversed_idx = length(l) - i + 1
            l[reversed_idx] *= tally
            tally = l[reversed_idx]
        end
    end
    
    if isnothing(start_edges)
        start_edges = [s == 0 for s in start_seq]
        reduce_edge_list(start_edges)
    end
    
    if isnothing(end_edges)
        end_edges = [e == (d - 1) for (e, d) in zip(end_seq, dims)]
        reduce_edge_list(end_edges)
    end
    
    if length(start_seq) == 0
        return [tuple()]
    elseif length(start_seq) == 1
        return [(start_seq[1]:end_seq[1],)]
    end
    
    slices = []
    path = []
    
    for (s, e) in zip(start_seq, end_seq)
        if s == e
            push!(path, s:s)
        else
            break
        end
    end
    
    path = tuple(path...)
    divergence_idx = length(path) + 1
    
    if divergence_idx > length(dims)
        return [tuple(path)]
    end
    
    function upper()
        sdi = start_seq[divergence_idx]
        return [
            tuple(path..., sdi:sdi, s...) for s in get_minimal_slice_set(
                start_seq[divergence_idx+1:end],
                [d - 1 for d in dims[divergence_idx+1:end]],
                dims[divergence_idx+1:end],
                start_edges=start_edges[divergence_idx+1:end],
                end_edges=[1 for _ in end_edges[divergence_idx+1:end]]
            )
        ]
    end
    
    function lower()
        edi = end_seq[divergence_idx]
        return [
            tuple(path..., edi:edi, s...) for s in get_minimal_slice_set(
                [0 for _ in start_seq[divergence_idx+1:end]],
                end_seq[divergence_idx+1:end],
                dims[divergence_idx+1:end],
                start_edges=[1 for _ in start_edges[divergence_idx+1:end]],
                end_edges=end_edges[divergence_idx+1:end]
            )
        ]
    end
    
    if start_edges[divergence_idx] && end_edges[divergence_idx]
        push!(slices, tuple(path..., start_seq[divergence_idx]:end_seq[divergence_idx]))
    elseif start_edges[divergence_idx]
        push!(slices, tuple(path..., start_seq[divergence_idx]:end_seq[divergence_idx]-1))
        append!(slices, lower())
    elseif end_edges[divergence_idx]
        append!(slices, upper())
        push!(slices, tuple(path..., start_seq[divergence_idx]+1:end_seq[divergence_idx]))
    else
        append!(slices, upper())
        middle_ground = end_seq[divergence_idx] - start_seq[divergence_idx]
        if middle_ground > 1
            push!(slices, tuple(path..., start_seq[divergence_idx]+1:end_seq[divergence_idx]-1))
        end
        append!(slices, lower())
    end
    
    return [tuple(s...) for s in slices]
end

function chunk_slice(t, flat_start, flat_end, no_batch_dims)
    batch_dims = size(t)[1:no_batch_dims]
    start_idx = collect(flat_idx_to_idx(flat_start, batch_dims))
    end_idx = collect(flat_idx_to_idx(flat_end - 1, batch_dims))
    
    slices = get_minimal_slice_set(start_idx, end_idx, batch_dims)
    
    sliced_tensors = [t[s...] for s in slices]
    
    return vcat([reshape(s, :, size(t)[no_batch_dims+1:end]...) for s in sliced_tensors]...)
end

function fetch_dims(tree)
    shapes = []
    if isa(tree, Dict)
        for v in values(tree)
            append!(shapes, fetch_dims(v))
        end
    elseif isa(tree, Array) || isa(tree, Tuple)
        for t in tree
            append!(shapes, fetch_dims(t))
        end
    elseif isa(tree, AbstractArray)
        push!(shapes, size(tree))
    else
        error("Not supported")
    end
    return shapes
end

function chunk_layer(layer, inputs, chunk_size, no_batch_dims; low_mem=false, _out=nothing, _add_into_out=false)
    if length(inputs) == 0
        error("Must provide at least one input")
    end
    
    initial_dims = [s[1:no_batch_dims] for s in fetch_dims(inputs)]
    orig_batch_dims = tuple([maximum([s[i] for s in initial_dims]) for i in 1:no_batch_dims]...)
    
    function prep_inputs(t)
        if !low_mem
            if sum(size(t)[1:no_batch_dims]) != no_batch_dims
                t = repeat(t, orig_batch_dims..., ones(Int, ndims(t) - no_batch_dims)...)
            end
            t = reshape(t, :, size(t)[no_batch_dims+1:end]...)
        else
            t = repeat(t, orig_batch_dims..., ones(Int, ndims(t) - no_batch_dims)...)
        end
        return t
    end
    
    prepped_inputs = Dict(k => prep_inputs(v) for (k, v) in inputs)
    prepped_outputs = nothing
    if !isnothing(_out)
        reshape_fn(t) = reshape(t, :, size(t)[no_batch_dims+1:end]...)
        prepped_outputs = Dict(k => reshape_fn(v) for (k, v) in _out)
    end
    
    flat_batch_dim = prod(orig_batch_dims)
    
    no_chunks = div(flat_batch_dim, chunk_size) + (mod(flat_batch_dim, chunk_size) != 0 ? 1 : 0)
    
    i = 1
    out = prepped_outputs
    for _ in 1:no_chunks
        if !low_mem
            select_chunk(t) = size(t, 1) != 1 ? t[i:min(i+chunk_size-1, size(t,1)), ..] : t
        else
            select_chunk(t) = chunk_slice(t, i-1, min(flat_batch_dim, i+chunk_size-1), no_batch_dims)
        end
        
        chunks = Dict(k => select_chunk(v) for (k, v) in prepped_inputs)
        
        output_chunk = layer(; chunks...)
        
        if isnothing(out)
            allocate(t) = zeros(eltype(t), flat_batch_dim, size(t)[2:end]...)
            out = Dict(k => allocate(v) for (k, v) in output_chunk)
        end
        
        if isa(output_chunk, Dict)
            function assign(d1, d2)
                for (k, v) in d1
                    if isa(v, Dict)
                        assign(v, d2[k])
                    else
                        if _add_into_out
                            v[i:min(i+chunk_size-1, size(v,1)), ..] .+= d2[k]
                        else
                            v[i:min(i+chunk_size-1, size(v,1)), ..] .= d2[k]
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            assign(out, output_chunk)
        elseif isa(output_chunk, Tuple)
            for (x1, x2) in zip(out, output_chunk)
                if _add_into_out
                    x1[i:min(i+chunk_size-1, size(x1,1)), ..] .+= x2
                else
                    x1[i:min(i+chunk_size-1, size(x1,1)), ..] .= x2
                end
            end
        else
            if _add_into_out
                out[i:min(i+chunk_size-1, size(out,1)), ..] .+= output_chunk
            else
                out[i:min(i+chunk_size-1, size(out,1)), ..] .= output_chunk
            end
        end
        
        i += chunk_size
    end
    
    reshape_fn(t) = reshape(t, orig_batch_dims..., size(t)[2:end]...)
    out = Dict(k => reshape_fn(v) for (k, v) in out)
    
    return out
end

mutable struct ChunkSizeTuner
    max_chunk_size::Int
    cached_chunk_size::Union{Nothing, Int}
    cached_arg_data::Union{Nothing, Any}
end

ChunkSizeTuner(; max_chunk_size=512) = ChunkSizeTuner(max_chunk_size, nothing, nothing)

function determine_favorable_chunk_size(tuner::ChunkSizeTuner, fn, args, min_chunk_size)
    println("Tuning chunk size...")
    
    if min_chunk_size >= tuner.max_chunk_size
        return min_chunk_size
    end
    
    candidates = [2^l for l in 0:Int(floor(log2(tuner.max_chunk_size)))]
    candidates = [c for c in candidates if c > min_chunk_size]
    candidates = [min_chunk_size, candidates...]
    candidates[end] += 4
    
    function test_chunk_size(chunk_size)
        try
            fn(args..., chunk_size=chunk_size)
            return true
        catch
            return false
        end
    end
    
    min_viable_chunk_size_index = 1
    i = length(candidates)
    while i > min_viable_chunk_size_index
        viable = test_chunk_size(candidates[i])
        if !viable
            i = div(min_viable_chunk_size_index + i, 2)
        else
            min_viable_chunk_size_index = i
            i = div(i + length(candidates), 2)
        end
    end
    
    return candidates[min_viable_chunk_size_index]
end

function compare_arg_caches(tuner::ChunkSizeTuner, ac1, ac2)
    consistent = true
    for (a1, a2) in zip(ac1, ac2)
        @assert typeof(ac1) == typeof(ac2)
        if isa(ac1, Array) || isa(ac1, Tuple)
            consistent &= compare_arg_caches(tuner, a1, a2)
        elseif isa(ac1, Dict)
            a1_items = [v for (k, v) in sort(collect(ac1), by=x->x[1])]
            a2_items = [v for (k, v) in sort(collect(ac2), by=x->x[1])]
            consistent &= compare_arg_caches(tuner, a1_items, a2_items)
        else
            consistent &= a1 == a2
        end
    end
    return consistent
end

function tune_chunk_size(tuner::ChunkSizeTuner, representative_fn, args, min_chunk_size)
    consistent = true
    remove_tensors(a) = isa(a, AbstractArray) ? size(a) : a
    arg_data = [remove_tensors(a) for a in args]
    
    if !isnothing(tuner.cached_arg_data)
        @assert length(tuner.cached_arg_data) == length(arg_data)
        consistent = compare_arg_caches(tuner, tuner.cached_arg_data, arg_data)
    else
        consistent = false
    end
    
    if !consistent
        tuner.cached_chunk_size = determine_favorable_chunk_size(tuner, representative_fn, args, min_chunk_size)
        tuner.cached_arg_data = arg_data
    end
    
    return tuner.cached_chunk_size
end

function get_chain_cluster(chain, record)
    return chain.cluster_id
end

function get_interface_cluster(interface, record)
    chain1 = record.chains[interface.chain_1]
    chain2 = record.chains[interface.chain_2]
    
    cluster_1 = string(chain1.cluster_id)
    cluster_2 = string(chain2.cluster_id)
    
    cluster_id = (cluster_1, cluster_2)
    cluster_id = tuple(sort([cluster_id...])...)
    
    return cluster_id
end

function get_chain_weight(chain, record, clusters, beta_chain, alpha_prot, alpha_nucl, alpha_ligand)
    prot_id = 1
    rna_id = 2
    dna_id = 3
    ligand_id = 4
    
    weight = beta_chain / clusters[chain.cluster_id]
    if chain.mol_type == prot_id
        weight *= alpha_prot
    elseif chain.mol_type in [rna_id, dna_id]
        weight *= alpha_nucl
    elseif chain.mol_type == ligand_id
        weight *= alpha_ligand
    end
    
    return weight
end

function get_interface_weight(interface, record, clusters, beta_interface, alpha_prot, alpha_nucl, alpha_ligand)
    prot_id = 1
    rna_id = 2
    dna_id = 3
    ligand_id = 4
    
    chain1 = record.chains[interface.chain_1]
    chain2 = record.chains[interface.chain_2]
    
    n_prot = chain1.mol_type == prot_id ? 1 : 0
    n_nuc = chain1.mol_type in [rna_id, dna_id] ? 1 : 0
    n_ligand = chain1.mol_type == ligand_id ? 1 : 0
    
    n_prot += chain2.mol_type == prot_id ? 1 : 0
    n_nuc += chain2.mol_type in [rna_id, dna_id] ? 1 : 0
    n_ligand += chain2.mol_type == ligand_id ? 1 : 0
    
    weight = beta_interface / clusters[get_interface_cluster(interface, record)]
    weight *= alpha_prot * n_prot + alpha_nucl * n_nuc + alpha_ligand * n_ligand
    return weight
end

mutable struct ClusterSampler
    alpha_prot::Float64
    alpha_nucl::Float64
    alpha_ligand::Float64
    beta_chain::Float64
    beta_interface::Float64
end

ClusterSampler(; alpha_prot=3.0, alpha_nucl=3.0, alpha_ligand=1.0, beta_chain=0.5, beta_interface=1.0) = 
    ClusterSampler(alpha_prot, alpha_nucl, alpha_ligand, beta_chain, beta_interface)

function sample(sampler::ClusterSampler, records, random_state)
    chain_clusters = Dict{String, Int}()
    for record in records
        for chain in record.chains
            if !chain.valid
                continue
            end
            cluster_id = get_chain_cluster(chain, record)
            if !haskey(chain_clusters, cluster_id)
                chain_clusters[cluster_id] = 0
            end
            chain_clusters[cluster_id] += 1
        end
    end
    
    interface_clusters = Dict{String, Int}()
    for record in records
        for interface in record.interfaces
            if !interface.valid
                continue
            end
            cluster_id = get_interface_cluster(interface, record)
            if !haskey(interface_clusters, cluster_id)
                interface_clusters[cluster_id] = 0
            end
            interface_clusters[cluster_id] += 1
        end
    end
    
    items = []
    weights = []
    for record in records
        for (chain_id, chain) in enumerate(record.chains)
            if !chain.valid
                continue
            end
            weight = get_chain_weight(
                chain,
                record,
                chain_clusters,
                sampler.beta_chain,
                sampler.alpha_prot,
                sampler.alpha_nucl,
                sampler.alpha_ligand
            )
            push!(items, (record, 0, chain_id))
            push!(weights, weight)
        end
        
        for (int_id, interface) in enumerate(record.interfaces)
            if !interface.valid
                continue
            end
            weight = get_interface_weight(
                interface,
                record,
                interface_clusters,
                sampler.beta_interface,
                sampler.alpha_prot,
                sampler.alpha_nucl,
                sampler.alpha_ligand
            )
            push!(items, (record, 1, int_id))
            push!(weights, weight)
        end
    end
    
    weights = weights ./ sum(weights)
    
    Channel() do ch
        while true
            item_idx = rand(random_state, Categorical(weights))
            record, kind, index = items[item_idx]
            if kind == 0
                put!(ch, (record=record, chain_id=index))
            else
                put!(ch, (record=record, interface_id=index))
            end
        end
    end
end

_IPTM_WEIGHT = 0.8
_FRACTION_DISORDERED_WEIGHT = 0.5
_CLASH_PENALIZATION_WEIGHT = 100.0

function compute_tm(p_pae; residue_weights=nothing, interface=false, asym_id=nothing)
    if isnothing(residue_weights)
        residue_weights = ones(size(p_pae)[2:3]...)
    end
    
    bin_edges = range(0, 32, length=65)
    bin_centers = (bin_edges[1:end-1] .+ bin_edges[2:end]) ./ 2
    
    probs = softmax(p_pae, dims=4)
    expected_pae = sum(probs .* reshape(bin_centers, 1, 1, 1, :), dims=4)[:, :, :, 1]
    
    if interface
        mask = asym_id .!= asym_id'
        expected_pae = expected_pae .* mask
    end
    
    d0 = 0.8
    tm_score = sum(1.0 ./ (1.0 .+ (expected_pae ./ d0).^2) .* residue_weights) / sum(residue_weights)
    
    return tm_score
end

function calculate_chain_based_ptm(p_pae, input_features)
    diffusion_batch_size = size(p_pae, 1)
    single_mask = input_features["seq_mask"]
    frame_mask = input_features["frame_mask"]
    asym_id = input_features["asym_id"]
    
    asym_id_to_asym_mask = Dict()
    for aid in unique(asym_id)
        if aid != 0
            asym_id_to_asym_mask[aid] = asym_id .== aid
        end
    end
    
    N_chain = length(asym_id_to_asym_mask)
    chain_ptm = zeros(Float32, diffusion_batch_size, N_chain)
    chain_pair_iptm = zeros(Float32, diffusion_batch_size, N_chain, N_chain)
    chain_iptm = zeros(Float32, diffusion_batch_size, N_chain)
    
    for index in 1:diffusion_batch_size
        for (aid, asym_mask) in asym_id_to_asym_mask
            chain_ptm[index, aid] = compute_tm(p_pae[index:index, :, :, :], residue_weights=frame_mask .* single_mask .* asym_mask)
        end
        
        for aid_i in 1:N_chain
            for aid_j in 1:N_chain
                if aid_i == aid_j
                    chain_pair_iptm[index, aid_i, aid_j] = chain_ptm[index, aid_i]
                    continue
                end
                if aid_i > aid_j
                    chain_pair_iptm[index, aid_i, aid_j] = chain_pair_iptm[index, aid_j, aid_i]
                end
                pair_asym_mask = asym_id_to_asym_mask[aid_i] .+ asym_id_to_asym_mask[aid_j]
                chain_pair_iptm[index, aid_i, aid_j] = compute_tm(
                    p_pae[index:index, :, :, :],
                    residue_weights=frame_mask .* single_mask .* pair_asym_mask,
                    interface=true,
                    asym_id=asym_id
                )
            end
        end
        
        for (aid, asym_mask) in asym_id_to_asym_mask
            pairs = [(i, j) for i in 1:N_chain for j in 1:N_chain if (i == aid || j == aid) && (i != j)]
            vals = [chain_pair_iptm[index, i, j] for (i, j) in pairs]
            if length(vals) > 0
                chain_iptm[index, aid] = mean(vals)
            end
        end
    end
    
    return chain_iptm, chain_pair_iptm, chain_ptm
end

function calculate_chain_based_plddt(plddt, input_features)
    diffusion_batch_size = size(plddt, 1)
    pred_dense_atom_mask = input_features["pred_dense_atom_mask"]
    single_mask = input_features["seq_mask"]
    asym_id = input_features["asym_id"]
    
    asym_id_to_asym_mask = Dict()
    for aid in unique(asym_id)
        if aid != 0
            asym_id_to_asym_mask[aid] = asym_id .== aid
        end
    end
    
    N_chain = length(asym_id_to_asym_mask)
    chain_plddt = zeros(Float32, diffusion_batch_size, N_chain)
    chain_pair_plddt = zeros(Float32, diffusion_batch_size, N_chain, N_chain)
    
    for index in 1:diffusion_batch_size
        for (aid, asym_mask) in asym_id_to_asym_mask
            asym_pred_dense_atom_mask = pred_dense_atom_mask .* reshape(asym_mask, size(asym_mask)..., 1)
            chain_plddt[index, aid] = mean(plddt[index, asym_pred_dense_atom_mask[1, :, :]])
        end
        
        for aid_i in 1:N_chain
            for aid_j in 1:N_chain
                if aid_i == aid_j
                    chain_pair_plddt[index, aid_i, aid_j] = chain_plddt[index, aid_i]
                    continue
                end
                if aid_i > aid_j
                    chain_pair_plddt[index, aid_i, aid_j] = chain_pair_plddt[index, aid_j, aid_i]
                end
                pair_asym_mask = asym_id_to_asym_mask[aid_i] .+ asym_id_to_asym_mask[aid_j]
                pair_asym_pred_dense_atom_mask = pred_dense_atom_mask .* reshape(pair_asym_mask, size(pair_asym_mask)..., 1)
                chain_pair_plddt[index, aid_i, aid_j] = mean(plddt[index, pair_asym_pred_dense_atom_mask[1, :, :]])
            end
        end
    end
    
    return chain_plddt, chain_pair_plddt
end

function calculate_clash(coords, input_features; cutoff_radius=1.1, min_clashes_for_overlap=100, min_fraction_for_overlap=0.5)
    has_clashes = zeros(Float32, size(coords, 1))
    is_polymer = (.!input_features["is_ligand"] .& input_features["seq_mask"])
    
    if sum(is_polymer) == 0
        return has_clashes
    end
    
    pred_dense_atom_mask = input_features["pred_dense_atom_mask"]
    pred_dense_atom_mask = pred_dense_atom_mask .* reshape(is_polymer, size(is_polymer)..., 1)
    coords = coords[:, pred_dense_atom_mask[1, :], :]
    
    max_atoms = 24
    atom_level_resid = repeat(input_features["residue_index"], 1, 1, max_atoms)[pred_dense_atom_mask]
    atom_level_chainid = repeat(input_features["asym_id"], 1, 1, max_atoms)[pred_dense_atom_mask]
    chain_ids = unique(atom_level_chainid)
    
    for index in 1:size(coords, 1)
        tree = KDTree(coords[index, :, :]')
        clashes_per_atom = inrange(tree, coords[index, :, :]', cutoff_radius)
        per_atom_has_clash = zeros(Int32, size(coords, 2))
        
        for (atom_idx, clashing_indices) in enumerate(clashes_per_atom)
            for clashing_idx in clashing_indices
                if abs(atom_level_resid[atom_idx] - atom_level_resid[clashing_idx]) > 1 || 
                   (atom_level_chainid[atom_idx] != atom_level_chainid[clashing_idx])
                    per_atom_has_clash[atom_idx] = 1
                    break
                end
            end
        end
        
        for chain_id in chain_ids
            mask = atom_level_chainid .== chain_id
            num_atoms = sum(mask)
            if num_atoms == 0
                continue
            end
            num_clashes = sum(per_atom_has_clash[mask])
            frac_clashes = num_clashes / num_atoms
            if num_clashes > min_clashes_for_overlap || frac_clashes > min_fraction_for_overlap
                has_clashes[index] = 1.0
                break
            end
        end
    end
    
    return has_clashes
end

function get_summary_confidence(outputs, input_features)
    x_predicted = outputs["x_predicted"]
    plddt = outputs["plddt"]
    pae = outputs["pae"]
    pde = outputs["pde"]
    ptm = outputs["ptm"]
    iptm = outputs["iptm"]
    
    chain_iptm, chain_pair_iptm, chain_ptm = calculate_chain_based_ptm(outputs["p_pae"], input_features)
    chain_plddt, chain_pair_plddt = calculate_chain_based_plddt(outputs["plddt"], input_features)
    has_clashes = calculate_clash(x_predicted, input_features)
    
    diffusion_batch_size = size(plddt, 1)
    summary_confidences_list = []
    
    global_plddt = mean(plddt[:, input_features["pred_dense_atom_mask"][1, :]], dims=2)
    
    for index in 1:diffusion_batch_size
        if iptm[index] == 0.0
            ptm_iptm_average = ptm[index]
        else
            ptm_iptm_average = _IPTM_WEIGHT * iptm[index] + (1.0 - _IPTM_WEIGHT) * ptm[index]
        end
        
        fraction_disordered = 0.0
        
        ranking_score = ptm_iptm_average + 
            _FRACTION_DISORDERED_WEIGHT * fraction_disordered - 
            _CLASH_PENALIZATION_WEIGHT * has_clashes[index]
        
        summary_confidences = Dict(
            "chain_plddt" => chain_plddt[index, :],
            "chain_pair_plddt" => chain_pair_plddt[index, :, :],
            "chain_iptm" => sum(chain_iptm[index, :]) > 0 ? chain_iptm[index, :] : fill(nothing, size(chain_iptm, 2)),
            "chain_pair_iptm" => chain_pair_iptm[index, :, :],
            "chain_ptm" => chain_ptm[index, :],
            "fraction_disordered" => fraction_disordered,
            "has_clash" => has_clashes[index],
            "plddt" => global_plddt[index],
            "iptm" => iptm[index] > 0.0 ? iptm[index] : nothing,
            "ptm" => ptm[index],
            "ranking_score" => ranking_score
        )
        push!(summary_confidences_list, summary_confidences)
    end
    
    return summary_confidences_list
end

function get_full_confidence(outputs, input_features, structure)
    x_predicted = outputs["x_predicted"]
    plddt = outputs["plddt"]
    pae = outputs["pae"]
    
    single_mask = input_features["seq_mask"][1, :]
    full_pae = pae[:, single_mask, single_mask]
    
    asym_id_to_chain_id = Dict()
    structure = remove_invalid_chains(structure)
    chains = structure.chains
    
    for chain_idx in 1:length(chains)
        chain = chains[chain_idx]
        asym_id_to_chain_id[chain.asym_id + 1] = chain.chain_id
    end
    
    pred_dense_atom_mask = input_features["pred_dense_atom_mask"]
    max_atoms = 24
    atom_level_resid = repeat(input_features["residue_index"], 1, 1, max_atoms)[pred_dense_atom_mask]
    atom_level_chainid = repeat(input_features["asym_id"], 1, 1, max_atoms)[pred_dense_atom_mask]
    atom_chain_ids = [asym_id_to_chain_id[id] for id in atom_level_chainid]
    
    atom_plddts = plddt[:, pred_dense_atom_mask[1, :]]
    
    asym_ids = input_features["asym_id"][1, single_mask]
    token_chain_ids = [asym_id_to_chain_id[id] for id in asym_ids]
    
    token_res_ids = input_features["residue_index"][1, single_mask]
    
    full_confidences_list = []
    diffusion_batch_size = size(plddt, 1)
    
    for index in 1:diffusion_batch_size
        full_confidences = Dict(
            "atom_chain_ids" => atom_chain_ids,
            "atom_plddts" => atom_plddts[index, :],
            "contact_probs" => nothing,
            "pae" => full_pae[index, :, :],
            "token_chain_ids" => token_chain_ids,
            "token_res_ids" => token_res_ids
        )
        push!(full_confidences_list, full_confidences)
    end
    
    return full_confidences_list
end

function pad_dim(data, dim, pad_len; value=0.0)
    if pad_len == 0
        return data
    end
    
    total_dims = ndims(data)
    padding = zeros(Int, 2 * (total_dims - dim + 1))
    padding[2 * (total_dims - dim + 1)] = pad_len
    
    return NNlib.pad_constant(data, tuple(padding...), value)
end

function pad_to_max(data; value=0.0)
    if isa(data[1], String)
        return data, 0
    end
    
    if all(size(d) == size(data[1]) for d in data)
        return cat(data..., dims=1), 0
    end
    
    num_dims = ndims(data[1])
    max_dims = [maximum(size(d, i) for d in data) for i in 1:num_dims]
    
    pad_lengths = []
    for d in data
        dims = []
        for i in 1:num_dims
            push!(dims, 0)
            push!(dims, max_dims[num_dims - i + 1] - size(d, num_dims - i + 1))
        end
        push!(pad_lengths, dims)
    end
    
    padding = [NNlib.pad_constant(ones(size(d)), tuple(pad_len...), 0.0) for (d, pad_len) in zip(data, pad_lengths)]
    data = [NNlib.pad_constant(d, tuple(pad_len...), value) for (d, pad_len) in zip(data, pad_lengths)]
    
    padding = cat(padding..., dims=1)
    data = cat(data..., dims=1)
    
    return data, padding
end
